Method of Attack: Buffer overflow caused by an unsafe variable in the Trusted Platform Module (TPM) configuration, potentially allowing malicious code execution
Impacted Systems: Phoenix SecureCore firmware on Intel processor families including Alder Lake, Coffee Lake, Comet Lake, Ice Lake, Jasper Lake, Kaby Lake, Meteor Lake, Raptor Lake, Rocket Lake, and Tiger Lake
Attack Vector: Local attackers escalating privileges and executing code within the UEFI firmware during runtime
